steps.title: Replatform the existing King’s Edge app
steps.summary: Rebuild the existing King’s Edge app on the agreed Azure and shared-application foundations between November 2026 and the end of January 2027. The replacement must achieve verified feature parity before cutover, preserving existing student records, content, operational workflows and service continuity while creating a stronger base for subsequent product development.

outputs.title: Opportunity catalogue and activity pages
outputs.summary: Preserve the existing catalogue and student-facing details for events, self-paced activity and other published opportunities.

outputs.title: Search, filters and curated discovery
outputs.summary: Preserve search, filtering, browsing, recommendations, curated collections and cohort-specific landing experiences.

outputs.title: Saved opportunities and calendar
outputs.summary: Preserve bookmarking or saving opportunities and the student calendar view of planned participation.

outputs.title: Registration and booking management
outputs.summary: Preserve student sign-up, booking status, capacity management, cancellations and associated confirmations.

outputs.title: Attendance and QR check-in
outputs.summary: Preserve attendance recording, including QR-enabled check-in and the operational tools used to manage attendance.

outputs.title: Self-paced and self-study activity
outputs.summary: Preserve access to on-demand and self-study opportunities and the associated participation and completion records.

outputs.title: Cohort restrictions and targeted curation
outputs.summary: Preserve staff controls for restricting, inviting and curating activity for defined student cohorts.

outputs.title: Independent activity and K-Points claims
outputs.summary: Preserve student claims for eligible independent activity, evidence upload, verification and the associated K-Points record.

outputs.title: Student dashboard and participation history
outputs.summary: Preserve the student view of bookings, attendance, completed activity, claims, K-Points and recognition status.

outputs.title: Notifications and participant communications
outputs.summary: Preserve service notifications and the communications used to support bookings, attendance and participation.

outputs.title: Staff activity and participant administration
outputs.summary: Preserve staff tools for creating and publishing activity, managing content and providers, administering participants and recording outcomes.

outputs.title: Reporting, analytics and audit
outputs.summary: Preserve operational reporting, engagement data, exports and audit trails required to run and evaluate the service.

outputs.title: Data, content and history migration
outputs.summary: Migrate the required live and historical records, validate parity and complete a controlled cutover without loss of service.

steps.title: Digital Badge Management Infrastructure
steps.summary: Deliver the in-house infrastructure for managing digital badges from February and complete it by the end of May 2027, including the migration and cutover required to replace Accredible. This epic provides the technical service and operational continuity; the future King’s Edge badge portfolio remains owned through the recognition proposition led by 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Badge definitions and metadata
outputs.summary: Create and manage badge metadata, criteria, evidence requirements, validity and presentation.

outputs.title: Issuer and administrator management
outputs.summary: Provide roles, permissions and workflows for authorised issuers and central administrators.

outputs.title: Issuance management
outputs.summary: Support automatic, staff-awarded and approved claim-based issuance through one governed service.

outputs.title: Student badge record
outputs.summary: Provide a student-facing record of earned credentials and their supporting criteria or evidence.

outputs.title: Public verification
outputs.summary: Provide secure public verification of valid credentials and their current status.

outputs.title: Revocation, correction and audit
outputs.summary: Provide controls and records for correcting, revoking, auditing and reporting badge activity.

outputs.title: Accredible migration and cutover
outputs.summary: Migrate or preserve the required issuers, badge definitions and credential records and validate continuity before the existing service is stood down.

outputs.title: Supported production service
outputs.summary: Complete accessibility, security, monitoring, documentation, support and named service-ownership arrangements.

steps.title: Multi-event Activity and Pathway Management
steps.summary: Extend the replatformed King’s Edge service from February and complete it by the end of May 2027 so it can manage programmes made up of several linked activities and curate coherent developmental pathways. This epic establishes the structured offer that King’s Canvas can subsequently connect students into.

outputs.title: Programme and component structure
outputs.summary: Allow staff to create a parent programme containing multiple events, self-paced activities or other components while retaining a clear relationship between the whole and its parts.

outputs.title: Programme-level enrolment
outputs.summary: Support enrolment to the whole programme, selected components or both, with clear participant status and capacity rules.

outputs.title: Required, optional and sequenced components
outputs.summary: Define which components are compulsory, optional, recommended or dependent on earlier participation.

outputs.title: Multi-session scheduling
outputs.summary: Present dates, locations, delivery modes and changes across all components through one coherent participant journey.

outputs.title: Attendance and progress aggregation
outputs.summary: Roll attendance, participation and progress from individual components into a programme-level view for students and staff.

outputs.title: Completion rules
outputs.summary: Determine programme completion using configurable combinations of attendance, activity completion, evidence and other approved requirements.

outputs.title: Shared programme resources and communications
outputs.summary: Provide common information, resources and participant communications across the programme while retaining component-specific content where needed.

outputs.title: Curated pathways and collections
outputs.summary: Create developmental routes that combine events, programmes, self-paced opportunities and later project experiences in a meaningful sequence.

outputs.title: Pathway progression and next steps
outputs.summary: Show completed, current and recommended next stages without forcing every pathway into a single linear model.

outputs.title: Programme and pathway reporting
outputs.summary: Provide programme-level participation, completion and progression reporting alongside the underlying component records.

steps.title: King’s Canvas prototype
steps.summary: Develop and test a bounded working prototype of King’s Canvas between June and August 2027. Use the replatformed opportunity catalogue and new pathway structures to help students articulate needs and aspirations, form a revisitable plan and move towards relevant next steps without committing prematurely to a full production service.

outputs.title: Visual planning interface
outputs.summary: Allow students to explore and organise needs, aspirations, priorities and intended next steps.

outputs.title: Saved and revisitable plan
outputs.summary: Create a persistent personal plan that students can return to and update over time.

outputs.title: Structured planning prompts
outputs.summary: Guide students from broad aspirations towards clearer priorities and practical actions.

outputs.title: Bounded AI coaching
outputs.summary: Use constrained AI-supported dialogue to help students articulate options without presenting authoritative advice.

outputs.title: Opportunity and pathway connections
outputs.summary: Connect Canvas content to relevant individual opportunities, multi-event programmes and curated pathways through controlled rules and curated routes.

outputs.title: Plan history and change
outputs.summary: Allow students to revisit earlier priorities and see how their plan has developed without presenting development as a fixed linear journey.

outputs.title: Closed student testing
outputs.summary: Test usefulness, accessibility, trust and interaction with a limited student cohort.

outputs.title: Prototype evaluation and next-stage decision
outputs.summary: Produce evidence, design changes, assurance requirements and a clear scope for subsequent beta development.

steps.title: Project-based Learning Delivery Tools
steps.summary: Develop the first tools for delivering project-based learning between June and August 2027, in parallel with the King’s Canvas prototype. Support structured project activity from brief and participant allocation through milestones, outputs and completion, without extending at this stage into automated team formation or a full external-partner portal.

outputs.title: Project briefs and templates
outputs.summary: Create reusable structures for defining a project’s purpose, challenge, expected outputs, duration, participation model and completion requirements.

outputs.title: Project spaces
outputs.summary: Provide a dedicated space for each project containing its brief, participants, resources, activity and current status.

outputs.title: Participant and team allocation
outputs.summary: Allow authorised staff to assign individuals or manually constituted teams and manage changes to participation.

outputs.title: Milestones, tasks and progress
outputs.summary: Set milestones and tasks, record progress and identify activity that is on track, delayed or complete.

outputs.title: Resources and project communications
outputs.summary: Provide shared resources and communications that support delivery over the life of a project.

outputs.title: Submissions and review
outputs.summary: Allow participants to submit outputs and authorised staff to review, comment on and record the status of those submissions.

outputs.title: Outputs and showcases
outputs.summary: Record project outputs and make selected work visible through controlled showcase routes.

outputs.title: Completion, evidence and recognition handoff
outputs.summary: Record verified project completion and supporting evidence so it can feed the recognition routes led through 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Project delivery reporting
outputs.summary: Provide staff with participation, progress, completion and output reporting across the project portfolio.

steps.title: Provider Curation and Managed Spaces
steps.summary: Enable faculties, services and approved internal providers to curate and manage their own offer within King’s Edge between August and September 2027. Introduce delegated ownership and managed presentation without weakening central standards, oversight or the coherence of the student experience. Direct external-provider access remains a later option.

outputs.title: Provider profiles and managed spaces
outputs.summary: Give each approved provider a recognisable space through which it can explain its offer and present relevant activity, programmes, pathways and projects.

outputs.title: Delegated provider roles
outputs.summary: Create provider-level administrator and editor permissions with clear boundaries between local management and central control.

outputs.title: Provider-owned catalogue views
outputs.summary: Allow providers to organise and present their own approved opportunities without creating a separate catalogue or duplicating source records.

outputs.title: Provider collections and pathways
outputs.summary: Allow providers to curate collections and developmental pathways from activity they own or are authorised to include.

outputs.title: Publishing and approval workflow
outputs.summary: Support drafting, review, approval, publication, amendment and withdrawal with appropriate central oversight.

outputs.title: Cohort targeting and presentation
outputs.summary: Allow authorised providers to tailor presentation and access for relevant cohorts while respecting institutional permissions and data rules.

outputs.title: Provider communications
outputs.summary: Support proportionate communications to participants and relevant audiences from within managed provider spaces.

outputs.title: Provider analytics
outputs.summary: Give providers insight into discovery, registration, participation and completion for the activity they manage.

outputs.title: Central moderation and governance
outputs.summary: Provide central visibility, standards, audit and intervention controls across all managed provider spaces.

steps.title: King’s Canvas beta and opportunity matching
steps.summary: Develop the prototype into a controlled beta between October and December 2027. Test how students move from plans into individual opportunities, programmes, pathways and projects, how Canvas remains useful over time and how aggregated needs can inform curation and commissioning.

outputs.title: Controlled King’s Canvas beta
outputs.summary: Release a more robust version to a wider but still bounded student cohort.

outputs.title: Plan-to-opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Test rules and curated recommendations that connect plans to relevant live opportunities.

outputs.title: Connections to programmes and pathways
outputs.summary: Connect student priorities to multi-event programmes and curated developmental routes.

outputs.title: Connections to projects
outputs.summary: Connect appropriate student priorities to available project-based learning experiences.

outputs.title: Progress and next-step prompts
outputs.summary: Help students revisit and update their plans and identify practical next steps over time.

outputs.title: Needs and provision insight
outputs.summary: Generate privacy-aware insight into recurring student needs and potential gaps in the opportunity offer.

outputs.title: Beta evaluation and release requirements
outputs.summary: Evaluate usefulness, accessibility, trust, matching quality and operational implications and define the requirements for supported live use.

steps.title: Integrated King’s Edge release
steps.summary: Bring the replatformed app, digital badge management, multi-event programmes and pathways, project-based learning tools, provider-managed spaces, King’s Canvas beta and evidence records together during January and February 2028 as one coherent and supportable King’s Edge release.

outputs.title: Coherent student experience
outputs.summary: Provide joined-up journeys across discovery, participation, programmes, pathways, projects, Canvas, evidence and badge records.

outputs.title: Coherent staff and provider experience
outputs.summary: Provide clear operational journeys across central administration, delegated provider management and project or programme delivery.

outputs.title: Integrated data and records
outputs.summary: Maintain continuity across activity, planning, participation, evidence and recognition records.

outputs.title: Production assurance
outputs.summary: Complete accessibility, security, privacy, performance and operational-readiness assurance.

outputs.title: Live product analytics
outputs.summary: Provide evidence on student, staff and provider use of the service and the quality of key journeys.

outputs.title: Transition and adoption
outputs.summary: Support students, providers and operational teams through the integrated release.

steps.title: Product operations and service stabilisation
steps.summary: Use March to June 2028 to stabilise the integrated service and establish routine product, support and operational practices.

outputs.title: Priority live-service fixes
outputs.summary: Resolve the most important defects, usability issues and operational gaps.

outputs.title: Product and service ownership
outputs.summary: Confirm decision rights and responsibilities for the roadmap and live service.

outputs.title: Support and release operations
outputs.summary: Embed incident, release, maintenance, monitoring and recovery arrangements.

outputs.title: Routine product cadence
outputs.summary: Establish a repeatable discovery, prioritisation, release and evaluation cycle.

outputs.title: Adoption and provider support
outputs.summary: Provide targeted support for effective use of the new capabilities.

outputs.title: Benefits and usage baseline
outputs.summary: Establish the live baseline for reach, depth, progression, provider adoption and service performance.

steps.title: Personalised planning, progression and reflection
steps.summary: Use live evidence during July to December 2028 to strengthen movement from planning into activity, from lighter-touch to deeper experiences, and from completion into reflection, evidence and recognition.

outputs.title: Improved opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Strengthen connections from Canvas priorities into relevant opportunities and next steps.

outputs.title: Progression pathways
outputs.summary: Support movement from introductory activity into deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Evidence and recognition connections
outputs.summary: Connect completion to verified evidence and the recognition routes led through 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Post-activity reflection
outputs.summary: Prompt students to articulate learning and decide what comes next.

outputs.title: Offer insight and curation
outputs.summary: Use participation and Canvas evidence to improve provision.

steps.title: King’s Edge in the shared student app
steps.summary: Move King’s Edge into the shared student-app environment during January to June 2029 while retaining ownership of the Edge proposition, content, curation and developmental journeys.

outputs.title: Shared home and navigation
outputs.summary: Make Edge available through common student-app entry points.

outputs.title: Shared profile, search and communications
outputs.summary: Reuse common capabilities where they meet the Edge need.

outputs.title: Continuity of records and journeys
outputs.summary: Preserve activity, evidence, recognition and planning records through the transition.

outputs.title: Retirement of duplicated functions
outputs.summary: Replace Edge-specific functions where common services are ready and supportable.

outputs.title: Focused Edge roadmap
outputs.summary: Continue selective development of Canvas, opportunities, programmes, projects and evidence.

steps.title: Mature King’s Edge product domain
steps.summary: Complete the transition during July to December 2029 into a stable product domain within the Student Experience Hub, with enduring ownership and continuous improvement.

outputs.title: Stable shared product domain
outputs.summary: Operate King’s Edge through the shared app and common service capabilities.

outputs.title: Enduring ownership
outputs.summary: Maintain clear product, service, content and operational accountability.

outputs.title: Analytics and continuous improvement
outputs.summary: Use product and participation evidence to prioritise ongoing improvements.

outputs.title: Controlled rationalisation
outputs.summary: Retire redundant components only where continuity and support are assured.
